papers.title: Abstract Rendering: Certified Rendering Under 3D Semantic Uncertainty
papers.inputs: scene plus continuous camera/scene uncertainty sets
papers.outputs: provable per-pixel rendered-image bounds and downstream certification
papers.central_contribution: Piecewise-linear abstract rendering bounds through projection, sorting and cumulative alpha aggregation; scales to scenes with up to 1M Gaussians.
papers.major_algorithms: linear relational approximations; abstract sorting/aggregation; auto_LiRPA/CROWN integration
papers.limitations: targets uncertainty sets and downstream certification, not specifically post-edit protected-region locality

papers.overlap_with_candidate_maveb_contributio: Strong collision for any broad 'first certified 3DGS rendering' claim.
papers.potential_unexplored_gap: A fixed-camera, concrete pre/post edited-subset alpha-mass locality certificate may be much cheaper and tailored to interactive editing, but must be compared directly.
